action.description: Final disposition for the target file

dependency_level.description: Atomic: must commit with related changes. Independent: standalone commit.

target_file.description: Primary doc file affected. For multi-file outputs, return one entry per file.

reasoning.description: Ordered list of justifications (classification, target resolution, prune reasons, schema deltas, security findings)

hash_before.description: sha256 first 12 chars of target_file body before change (empty for create)

hash_after.description: sha256 first 12 chars of target_file body after change (empty for delete)

blocked_reason.description: Required when action=blocked. E.g., 'secret-detected: AWS access key'
